messages:
Liz (CS): Heads up — noticed ~350 accounts lost health scores after last night's SF->CRM sync. Onboarding playbooks rely on score>70. Anyone else seeing this?
Alex (RevOps): Saw a spike in untriaged accounts in the dashboard. Could be mapping change between `account_segment` and `segment_v2`.
June (Onboarding): This is impacting new cohort enablement. We had 18 scheduled 1:1s auto-assigned to 'at-risk' and they disappeared 😬
Alina (Data): I'm pulling logs now. Quick check — did the migration drop `account_health` or just the calc job failing?
crm-bot: cron/health-score-run: started 1768001200 by schedule
Alina (Data): Looking at the job logs: `KeyError: 'legacy_quota'` at step compute_risk. That would short-circuit scoring.
Liz (CS): Ugh. Any quick mitigation? Can we fallback to last known score or flag as 'needs manual review'?
Alex (RevOps): Propose we flip playbook condition to `health_score is not null` -> `health_score >= 0` temporarily, or gate by `last_scored_at > now()-30d`.
June (Onboarding): If it's a config change we can roll within Redwood Console. But want to avoid false-negatives.
Alina (Data): Patch ready — will backfill missing `legacy_quota` from `quota_history` for affected accounts and re-run scoring. SQL I plan to run: ```sql
UPDATE accounts a
SET legacy_quota = q.quota
FROM quota_history q
WHERE a.id = q.account_id AND q.ts = (
  SELECT max(ts) FROM quota_history WHERE account_id = a.id
)
AND a.legacy_quota IS NULL;
```
Sanjay (CSM): Can we run on a canary set first? Suggest 1k accounts from EU region.
Alina (Data): Yes, will run canary now. Kickoff ID `canary-1768001234`.
crm-bot: cron/health-score-run: completed canary run, 1k rows updated, 0 errors.
Liz (CS): :tada: Can you push the full backfill after validation? Also update the onboarding playbook to queue only if `last_scored_at IS NULL` for now.
Alex (RevOps): I'll update playbook rule and add a toggle in the dashboard under 'Playbooks > Onboarding' labeled `ignore-missing-scores`.
June (Onboarding): Once done, I'll reassign the 18 1:1s and ping customers.
Alina (Data): Full backfill scheduled in 30m, estimate 45m. I'll post results.
crm-bot: job/backfill-1768001234: started
crm-bot: job/backfill-1768001234: completed, 12,412 rows updated; 2 warnings (missing quota_history), re-run recommended for those 2.
Liz (CS): Thanks team. Can we add a check in the sync pipeline so missing `legacy_quota` fails with a warning instead of exception? Then playbook can handle gracefully.
Alina (Data): Agree — I'll add schema validation and a metric to Sentry/Prometheus.
Alex (RevOps): I'll follow up with a quick doc in Confluence + a runbook for next time.
